description: Implement Admin Product CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) with modals for adding and editing products, validation, and confirmation dialogs. Allows admin to manage product catalog directly from dashboard.
steps: Add getNextProductId() helper function to database.js that returns Math.max(...getProducts().map(p => p.id), 0) + 1

Create 'Add Product' modal in index.html after existing modals with form fields: name (text, required), category (select with options: Vegetables/Fruits/Rice & Grains/Root Crops, required), price (number, min=0, required), unit (text, required), stock (number, min=0, required), farmer (text, required), origin (text, required), tag (text, required), emoji (text, required, maxlength=2), description (textarea, required), image (url text, required). Include save and cancel buttons. Style like registerDialog form.
Wire up existing addProductButton in admin Products panel to open Add Product modal

In app.js, add handleAddProduct event listener for Add Product form submit. Validate all fields, call getNextProductId(), create product object with id, all form fields, call addProduct(), show success toast, close modal, reset form, call loadAdminData() to refresh products table
Create 'Edit Product' modal in index.html (clone of Add Product but with title 'Edit Product' and id='editProductDialog'). Include hidden input for product id.

Make product table rows clickable in loadAdminData(): add data-product-id attribute to each <tr> and click handler. On click, find product by id, populate editProductDialog form fields with product data, show modal

Add handleEditProduct handler for Edit Product form submit: get product id from hidden field, get form values, call updateProduct(id, updates), show success toast, close modal, call loadAdminData() to refresh

Add 'Delete' button to each product table row (small red button in new Actions column). On click, show confirmation modal 'Delete [product name]? This cannot be undone.' with Confirm Delete and Cancel buttons

Add handleDeleteProduct handler: on confirm, call deleteProduct(id), show success toast, close modal, call loadAdminData() to refresh. Ensure product is removed from both products table and top products list

Add form validation feedback: show inline error messages below fields when validation fails, red border on invalid fields. Validate price and stock are positive numbers, all required fields filled, valid URL format for image
acceptance_criteria: Admin can click '+ Add product' button to open Add Product modal
Add Product form validates all required fields with inline error messages
Submitting valid Add Product form creates new product, shows in products table, persists to localStorage
Clicking any product table row opens Edit Product modal with pre-filled data
Editing product updates localStorage and refreshes admin view
Delete button on product row shows confirmation modal
Confirming delete removes product from products table and localStorage
All CRUD operations show success toast notifications
Forms validate price/stock are numbers >= 0, image is valid URL
verification: Login as admin, go to Products tab
Click '+ Add product' - verify modal opens with empty form
Try submitting with missing fields - verify validation errors appear
Fill all fields with valid data, submit - verify success toast and new product appears in table
Click the new product row - verify Edit Product modal opens with pre-filled data
Change product name, submit - verify update succeeds and table refreshes
Click Delete on a product - verify confirmation modal appears
Confirm delete - verify product removed from table and localStorage
Refresh page - verify CRUD changes persisted
findings: Implementation complete. All product CRUD features working as expected: getNextProductId helper function added to database.js, Add Product modal created with all required fields (name, category, price, unit, stock, farmer, origin, tag, emoji, image URL, description), addProductButton now opens modal instead of showing placeholder message, handleAddProduct form submission creates new product with generated ID and refreshes both admin table and buyer product grid, Edit Product modal created as clone of Add Product with pre-population, products table rows made clickable to open edit modal via openEditProductModal function, handleEditProduct updates product and refreshes views, Delete Product confirmation modal created with product name display, delete button added to each product table row in Actions column, confirmDeleteProduct removes product from database and refreshes, cancelDeleteProduct closes modal without action, all CRUD functions made global for onclick handlers, HTML form validation with required fields, number min constraints, URL validation, maxlength for emoji field. All changes persist to localStorage and update both admin and buyer views.
